prompt.project_info: Create a realistic vertical convenience-store portrait of an original approved adult woman using an attached adult face reference when identity continuity is needed.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with dark shoulder-length hair and a contemplative downward gaze sits on a round wooden stool in a convenience store. She wears a white cotton-poplin button-down blouse, navy-and-white striped bow tie, and high-waisted navy plaid pleated skirt. Both hands hold a black katana prop across her lap; keep the blade safely controlled and non-threatening as shown in the reference.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium full-body profile framing, wooden counter and stool, shelves of colorful snacks and bottled drinks, Japanese-style signage, checkout area, bright fluorescent ceiling lights, warm pendant lamps, and realistic reflections and shadows.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dual-source cool fluorescent and warm pendant lighting, crisp convenience-store detail, neutral contemplative expression, candid surreal everyday atmosphere.
